017package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.dev.flavors;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.bean.html5.HtmlBuilder.*;
020
021import java.util.*;
022
023import org.apache.juneau.bean.html5.*;
024import org.apache.juneau.marshall.html.*;
025import org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.*;
027import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.*;
028
029/**
030 * The Html rendering flavor: the pet list built with the HTML5 bean builder.
031 *
032 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
033 * <p class='bjava'>
034 *    <jc>// GET /console/dev/flavors/html/fragment returns a bare table, no page chrome:</jc>
035 *    <jc>// &lt;table class="petstore-flavor" data-flavor="html"&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;th&gt;Name&lt;/th&gt;...</jc>
036 * </p>
037 */
038@Rest(path="/html", title="Html flavor")
039@SuppressWarnings({
040   "java:S110" // Inheritance depth comes from the BasicRestServlet hierarchy, not this page.
041})
042public class HtmlFlavorRest extends PetstoreConsolePage {
043
044   private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
045
046   /**
047    * The console page, from its builder twin on {@code ?builder}.
048    *
049    * @param req The request.
050    * @return The console page.
051    */
052   @RestGet(path="/")
053   public View page(RestRequest req) {
054      return Flavor.HTML.page(req);
055   }
056
057   /** @return The pet list as a bare HTML table. */
058   @RestGet(path="/fragment", serializers=HtmlSerializer.class)
059   public Table fragment() {
060      var rows = new ArrayList<Object>();
061      rows.add(tr(th("Name"), th("Species"), th("Price"), th("Status")));
062      for (var r : FlavorPets.rows(store()))
063         rows.add(tr(td(r.get("name")), td(r.get("species")), td(r.get("price")), td(r.get("status"))));
064      return table(rows.toArray()).class_("petstore-flavor").attr("data-flavor", "html");
065   }
066}
